mapper.insert: insert into bus_gd_pf_info (gd_pid,sharehold_code,gd_type,hole_share_amount,shareholding_proportion,gd_dj,trade_account,frozen_share_amount, pledged_share_amount,cash_bonus, bonus_issue,pf_pid) select * from(select pid as gd_pid,shareholders_code as sharehold_code,'PSN' gd_type, hole_share_amount as hole_share_amount,shareholding_proportion as shareholding_proportion,dj_status as gd_dj, trade_account as trade_account,frozen_share_amount as frozen_share_amount,pledged_share_amount as pledged_share_amount, #{cashBonus} as cash_bonus,#{bonusIssue} as bonus_issue,#{pfPid} as pf_pid from bus_rel_psn where is_shareholder = '1' and DELFLAG_ = '1' and status = '6' union ALL select pid as gd_pid,shareholders_code as sharehold_code,'ORG' as gd_type,hole_share_amount as hole_share_amount, shareholding_proportion as shareholding_proportion,dj_status as gd_dj,trade_account as trade_account,frozen_share as frozen_share_amount, pledged_share as pledged_share_amount,#{cashBonus} as cash_bonus,#{bonusIssue} as bonus_issue,#{pfPid} as pf_pid from bus_rel_org where is_shareholder = '1' and DELFLAG_ = '1' and status = '6') as allGdInfo
